ru-0522.title: Google car: Gen 4 widespread, not Altai or Far East
ru-0522.summary: Gen 4 is found in most regions. The Altai mountains and most of the Far East have none. Season and car matter more than this at a beginner level.

ru-24Ka.title: Fence: rounded rectangles with a middle line
ru-24Ka.summary: Rounded rectangular fences with a line through the middle are unique to Chelyabinsk Oblast and eastern Orenburg Oblast.

ru-2mXt.title: Plants: Russian olive along the border
ru-2mXt.summary: The Russian olive grows mostly along the Kazakhstan border.

ru-2n7S.title: Pole: painted red
ru-2n7S.summary: Red painted poles are only in Murom.

ru-344J.title: Bollard: grey rectangle with two red reflectors
ru-344J.summary: A unique bollard with a grey rectangle and two red reflectors, only on the P100 in Kostroma Oblast.

ru-3ve1.title: Fence: decorative bright orange
ru-3ve1.summary: Decoratively designed fences, usually bright orange, are unique to Irkutsk.

ru-4DR5.title: Bollard: very thin one on a stick, east
ru-4DR5.summary: The very thin bollard on a stick is usually in the east, starting around one Siberian city. Ordinary bollards remain plentiful there.

ru-4Mgv.title: Google car: large red brake light
ru-4Mgv.summary: A large red brake light is common in the western exclave, and appears in some older western coverage.

ru-4aKj.title: Landscape: lush hilly forests, overcast, white car
ru-4aKj.summary: The warm south-east around the port city has lush mixed forests on hills, mostly overcast coverage with a white long-antenna car. Further south, a more open rolling landscape.

ru-7siN.title: Coverage: autumn Gen 4, rare
ru-7siN.summary: Autumn Gen 4 is rare: around Kazan, a few roads in the far north-west and part of Ulan-Ude.

ru-8PIl.title: Plants: giant butterbur, huge round leaves
ru-8PIl.summary: Giant butterbur ('Sakhalin cabbage') is very common on the Far East island, mostly in the south half. Related plants rarely appear near the Black Sea.

ru-91yN.title: Landscape: green farm fields with birch patches
ru-91yN.summary: One Siberian region's summer Gen 4 shows green farm fields interrupted by isolated patches of birch forest. In Gen 3 this landscape covers a much larger area.

ru-920v.title: Pole: striped red and white
ru-920v.summary: Striped red and white poles are mostly in one republic capital and a few other towns of that republic.

ru-ABdR.title: Landscape: rocks along the road
ru-ABdR.summary: Rocks along the road are extremely common in the north-west, and smaller and rarer in the Urals and near the big Siberian lake.

ru-AsJS.title: Google car: blurrier long-antenna car
ru-AsJS.summary: A long antenna that is visibly blurrier than others: strong for Sakhalin, roads in the east and much of Khanty-Mansi, but also in far west Bryansk and some of Tula.

ru-B27i.title: Plate: fully white, black text
ru-B27i.summary: Fully white plates with black text and no blue strip on the left like most of Europe.

ru-BBhW.title: Language: Mari signs say 'урем'
ru-BBhW.summary: Mari bilingual signs use урем for street.

ru-BhB9.title: Signs: brown tourist attraction signs
ru-BhB9.summary: Brown signs pointing to tourist attractions are common around the capital and its neighbouring regions, and less often in city centres elsewhere.

ru-EAAw.title: Pole: black-and-white striped shields on highways
ru-EAAw.summary: Black-and-white striped shields on poles along highways, especially in the European part.

ru-EN2b.title: Signposts: clips on the edges
ru-EN2b.summary: Clips on the edges of signposts are found around the north-west big city and its region, very rarely in neighbouring ones.

ru-ENMg.title: Pole: alternating red and white
ru-ENMg.summary: Alternating red and white poles are mainly in one Volga city, less often around another and randomly elsewhere.

ru-F3DF.title: Cars: right-hand-drive Japanese cars in the east
ru-F3DF.summary: Right-hand-drive Japanese-made cars become more common going east, starting around the big Siberian city.

ru-FB0Q.title: Plants: Siberian larch, needle leaves
ru-FB0Q.summary: Siberian larches dominate much of the east, with needle-like leaves. They become more common the further east and at high altitude.

ru-FXIF.title: Google car: B-type antenna with rectangular ridge
ru-FXIF.summary: Like the B-type but with a more rectangular ridge. Common near Moscow, Kurgan, Krasnoyarsk and south-west Krasnodar.

ru-FyT4.title: Coverage: sunset, eastern landscape
ru-FyT4.summary: Sunset coverage with the sun very close to the horizon and an eastern landscape is road P-297, between two Far East towns.

ru-HjJe.title: Google car: A-type short antenna, high ridge right
ru-HjJe.summary: The A-type short antenna has its highest ridge on the right. Notable around Kaluga, Orenburg and Krasnodar.

ru-Ht2R.title: Pole: mesh-framework utility poles
ru-Ht2R.summary: Utility poles with a mesh framework are usually in Petrozavodsk, much less often in cities like Tolyatti.

ru-I6aA.title: Roads: cobblestone pavement
ru-I6aA.summary: Cobblestone pavement is notably common in the western exclave, one Urals industrial town and one in the Perm region.

ru-IeTE.title: Landscape: sandy hills at sunset, big lake
ru-IeTE.summary: An island in the big Siberian lake has a single road over rolling sandy hills at sunset, often showing the lake and a mountain ridge across the bay.

ru-JN8Z.title: Google car: white long-antenna car
ru-JN8Z.summary: The white long-antenna car appears in southern Chelyabinsk, in snow coverage around one Siberian city and in the Far East from Amur Oblast on. Kamchatka's silver car often looks white.

ru-Ja8F.title: Soil: very gravelly dark soil near eastern mountains
ru-Ja8F.summary: Extremely gravelly, sometimes dark soil approaches the mountains east of one far-eastern city.

ru-Jm4W.title: Houses: white limestone brick
ru-Jm4W.summary: White limestone brick buildings point to one southern republic and adjacent regions. Works better the more brick buildings you see.

ru-K40M.title: Google car: black car, long antenna, mountains and fog
ru-K40M.summary: The main road of one southern mountain republic has a black long-antenna car driving north through mountains, often foggy or rainy.

ru-K6A7.title: Landscape: grey gravelly soil, many volcanoes
ru-K6A7.summary: The Far East peninsula has grey gravelly soil and the most volcanoes in the country, often seen quite close.

ru-KHIG.title: Coverage: flat desert, dirt tracks, Gen 4
ru-KHIG.summary: Completely flat rural Gen 4 on small, poorly tracked dirt roads in the desert west of the Caspian Sea, only in northern Dagestan and south-west Astrakhan.

ru-KNFH.title: Coverage: tall hazy hills, unpaved dark gravel road
ru-KNFH.summary: The eastern half of the Kolyma Highway has tall hills and mountains in haze, unpaved roads and dark gravelly soil. The west half has no haze.

ru-KOU6.title: Google car: white Gen 4 car
ru-KOU6.summary: Gen 4 white car: May coverage near Lipetsk, in Moscow city, and across all coverage north of Berkakit in Sakha and in Magadan.

ru-LBZi.title: Landscape: open hills, low shrubs, fireweed
ru-LBZi.summary: Open hilly land with low shrubs and fireweed usually means the far north-west. The lower the shrubs, the further north.

ru-LP1h.title: Plants: birches packed tight, birch-only forests
ru-LP1h.summary: Birches very close together, and forests of only birch, mean east of the Urals, most common between two central Siberian regions.

ru-LPj1.title: Pole: extended insulator bars
ru-LPj1.summary: Extended insulator bars on poles, notably in southern Chelyabinsk, eastern Orenburg and southern Kemerovo.

ru-LVQ6.title: Road: crossings with white and yellow stripes
ru-LVQ6.summary: Pedestrian crossings have alternating white and yellow stripes. Common in Kazakhstan too.

ru-MFON.title: Plants: blue lupines
ru-MFON.summary: Blue lupines are very common in a few regions north-east of the capital, less common in Kirov and toward the Baltics.

ru-NFlW.title: Bus stops: shelters unique to regions
ru-NFlW.summary: Some federal regions have bus stops that are unique to them. Notable ones are in a Siberian territory and three Volga republics.

ru-O53i.title: Mosques: common in the south and two Volga republics
ru-O53i.summary: Mosques appear everywhere but are far more common in areas with a Muslim majority: much of the south and two Volga republics.

ru-O98Q.title: Language: Bashkir signs say 'урамы'
ru-O98Q.summary: Bashkir bilingual signs also use урамы for street, but often not abbreviated.

ru-OENY.title: Signposts: two yellow bands
ru-OENY.summary: On the main road of the far north-west city in Gen 4, and some roads in Karelia from 2018, most signposts have two yellow bands.

ru-OKfi.title: Plants: tall white flower heads (hogweed)
ru-OKfi.summary: Tall white flowers of Sosnowsky's hogweed are most common around the capital, in the north-west Komi region and near the Urals.

ru-OYvI.title: Pipes: raised above ground on vertical pipes
ru-OYvI.summary: In towns, pipes run exposed above ground, held up by vertical pipes. Georgia and Ukraine have this too, Ukraine less often.

ru-Ohdq.title: Google car: black Gen 4 car
ru-Ohdq.summary: Gen 4 black car: mostly near Moscow, Tver and Voronezh, some in Tatarstan and less often in the south.

ru-Om12.title: Coverage: one road, rainy and foggy in the west
ru-Om12.summary: A small Far East region has basically one road of coverage apart from its capital. The west side is very rainy and foggy.

ru-PJiO.title: Road lines: outer dashed lines
ru-PJiO.summary: Outer dashed lines are usual in one south-western region. Exceptions in a Siberian republic and, rarely, in the north-west and Far East.

ru-PVJx.title: Pole: square concrete
ru-PVJx.summary: Mostly square concrete poles. Ukraine, Lithuania, Estonia, Georgia, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan have them too.

ru-PzBt.title: Sign: decorative pedestrian sign holders
ru-PzBt.summary: A distinctive decorative design of pedestrian sign holders is specific to Pskov Oblast.

ru-QkQy.title: Coverage: very hazy, orange or white
ru-QkQy.summary: Very hazy coverage east and south of one diamond-mining town, especially along a river. Haze is often orange or white.

ru-RADI.title: Google car: A-type long antenna, high ridge right
ru-RADI.summary: The A-type long antenna has its highest ridge on the right. Notable in the north-west. Almost all white long-antenna cars are A-type.

ru-SZCQ.title: Landscape: dry steppe mountains, long antenna
ru-SZCQ.summary: Dry steppe mountains with a long antenna usually mean one southern Siberian republic. The south of the neighbouring mountain republic's road looks similar, so use driving direction and clouds.

ru-SdNy.title: Plants: spruce, dark dense droopy branches
ru-SdNy.summary: Spruce is evergreen, dark and dense with droopy or parallel branches. Caucasian fir has straighter, more orderly branches. Larches have upward, less dense, unruly branches and can look similar.

ru-SwXM.title: Google car: red Gen 4 car
ru-SwXM.summary: The most common Gen 4 car: mainly in the east around Khanty-Mansi and along main highways to Irkutsk and Ulan-Ude, with patches near Penza, Tatarstan and Rostov-on-Don.

ru-TE6r.title: Landscape: extremely dry and flat
ru-TE6r.summary: The area west of the Caspian Sea is extremely dry and flat, especially in the three regions there.

ru-U8sf.title: Google car: short antenna tilted left
ru-U8sf.summary: A short antenna visibly tilted to the left, mostly on a diagonal from St. Petersburg to Volgograd, with exceptions around Stavropol and Ufa. It can look like the A-type.

ru-UcDG.title: Road: mountains, sunny, black car with blurred antenna
ru-UcDG.summary: A mountainous road in sunny coverage driving west, with a black car with a blurred long antenna.

ru-UwoE.title: Coverage: forest fire haze, open rolling land
ru-UwoE.summary: Forest fire haze near a lake south-west of the republic capital. It resembles the haze near the diamond town but has an open rolling landscape.

ru-WkyB.title: Plants: white peeling birch bark
ru-WkyB.summary: Birches have a wide range but almost never grow in the far south or far north in the west.

ru-X2he.title: Plates: regional code on the right
ru-X2he.summary: In Gen 3 you sometimes see unblurred plates with a regional code on the right, ordered alphabetically within each type of region, so 01 is the first republic and 28 an oblast. Three-digit codes add extra regions.

ru-XM6p.title: Phone numbers: area code first digit shows region
ru-XM6p.summary: Area codes starting with 8 are in the west, 3 fairly central, and 4 either east or around the capital.

ru-YXiH.title: Road: larches, big mountains, Gen 4 white car
ru-YXiH.summary: Siberian larches, large mountains and a mostly paved road, sometimes with wide gravel, mean the main road south of one far-eastern city. A Gen 4 white car appears further north.

ru-YqxG.title: Guardrail: black and white stripes
ru-YqxG.summary: Black-and-white striped guardrails, kerbs and bridge barriers are common.

ru-ZPuK.title: Street sign: circular with up to 4 languages
ru-ZPuK.summary: One Volga republic's capital has an exclusive circular street sign with the name in up to four languages.

ru-ZovR.title: Coverage: wet after rain, east side
ru-ZovR.summary: On the east side of that region, the coverage changes from rainy to wet after rain.

ru-aGiM.title: Language: town names in Cyrillic and Latin
ru-aGiM.summary: Town names in both Cyrillic and Latin are common near the Baltic border, around the capital and, less so, near Finland.

ru-aHVz.title: Landscape: green river basin, jagged mountains north
ru-aHVz.summary: A national park in western Buryatia is a very green river basin with tall jagged mountains to the north, much greener than most of the republic.

ru-aRud.title: Language: 'улица' means street
ru-aRud.summary: Street is улица, short ул. Bulgarian and most Slavic languages say something similar, but Ukrainian says вулиця.

ru-aWaE.title: Fence: thin rounded rectangle top
ru-aWaE.summary: A fence with a thin rounded rectangular design at the top, in Syzran, Tolyatti and Samara. In Tolyatti it is commonly yellow.

ru-bXD0.title: Signposts: black painted bottoms
ru-bXD0.summary: Signposts often have black painted bottoms. Common in Kazakhstan too.

ru-cqfa.title: Language: 'город' means city
ru-cqfa.summary: City is город, short г. Ukrainian says місто, short м.

ru-dbaI.title: Language: Cyrillic with Ы, Э, Ё, Ъ
ru-dbaI.summary: Cyrillic script with the letters Ы, Э, Ё and Ъ. Russian also appears rarely in Ukraine and eastern Estonia.

differs.how: Ukrainian has Є, Ґ, І, Ї instead

ru-dzLd.title: Google car: B-type short antenna, high ridge left
ru-dzLd.summary: The B-type short antenna has its highest ridge on the left. Wide-ranging, but notable near Nizhny Novgorod, Elista, Yekaterinburg and Tyumen.

ru-eHxy.title: Plants: black poplar near Ukraine and Kazakhstan
ru-eHxy.summary: Black poplars are common in the south near Ukraine and toward Kazakhstan's border.

ru-eXFX.title: Language: Komi signs say 'улича'
ru-eXFX.summary: Komi bilingual signs use улича for street.

ru-epdP.title: Landscape: open grass, shrubs and mountains
ru-epdP.summary: Open grassy land with shrubs and mountains. Lusher near the big lake, but the mountains stay.

ru-fDEc.title: Google car: blurrier short antenna
ru-fDEc.summary: A short antenna that is visibly blurrier than the other types. Two clusters: around Ufa, and from Stavropol to Makhachkala.

ru-fV2M.title: Coverage: map of coverage, sparse in east and north
ru-fV2M.summary: The coverage map shows large gaps. Coverage is very sparse in the east and north.

ru-gi5v.title: Pole: yellow plates on a metal band
ru-gi5v.summary: Yellow pole plates attached with a metal band are common in one Volga republic, on most but not all poles.

ru-grzn.title: Landscape: flat, very low vegetation, far north
ru-grzn.summary: The far north is relatively flat with very low plants.

ru-h2Gm.title: Roads: lots of bollards at intersections
ru-h2Gm.summary: Intersections often have a very large number of bollards.

ru-hjXS.title: Signs: black sign bottoms in the south
ru-hjXS.summary: Black sign bottoms are mostly in two southern regions and west Dagestan. Rare exceptions in other southern regions are usually uncoloured.

ru-i2zA.title: Soil: sandy roadsides
ru-i2zA.summary: Sandy roadsides are common in two western Siberian regions, near one Volga city, and in Karelia, the far north-west and western Sakha. They also appear near rivers elsewhere.

ru-iFTC.title: Coverage: winter Gen 4 in the south
ru-iFTC.summary: Winter Gen 4 is most common in the south, from Ryazan down to Kabardino-Balkaria and Dagestan. Its look varies by month.

ru-jLBa.title: Houses: green roofs, red brick with white stone
ru-jLBa.summary: Historic buildings in one Volga republic often have green roofs and red brick with white stone details. Local churches share the style.

ru-jZWe.title: Sign: pedestrian sign, three stripes
ru-jZWe.summary: Simple person with three stripes, often with a bright yellow border. Ukraine, Lithuania, Mongolia, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan use the same design.

ru-jeND.title: Plants: sunflowers near Ukraine and the Volga
ru-jeND.summary: Sunflowers are common along the Ukraine border and in eastern Volga-Urals regions.

ru-kBRg.title: Sign: hanging pedestrian signs
ru-kBRg.summary: Nizhnevartovsk has unique hanging pedestrian signs.

ru-kMlj.title: Sign: pedestrian sign hung on a U-shaped hook
ru-kMlj.summary: Pedestrian signs with a U-shaped hook attached to a pole are unique to Chelyabinsk.

ru-l2qi.title: Houses: almost entirely red brick
ru-l2qi.summary: Almost entirely red brick buildings are mostly in the south, with three industrial cities as exceptions. Works better the more brick you see.

ru-lQl1.title: Coverage: spring Gen 4 in a few places
ru-lQl1.summary: Spring Gen 4 is common around Kemerovo, Krasnoyarsk, Orenburg, Kamyshin, Lipetsk and Moscow city. Landscape tells these apart.

ru-lb3J.title: Plants: lined oaks with a white stripe
ru-lb3J.summary: Lined oak trees, often with a white stripe around the trunk, are extremely common in the western exclave.

ru-leH6.title: Coverage: dead winter, raised apartment blocks
ru-leH6.summary: A far northern mining town in winter, with dead-looking surroundings, sometimes reddish soil, and apartment blocks on large raised foundations.

ru-lm-13426.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign
ru-lm-13426.summary: The sign reads ИЖЕВСК (Izhevsk). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-13427.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign
ru-lm-13427.summary: The sign reads НИЖНИЙ ТАГИЛ (Nizhniy Tagil). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-13428.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign
ru-lm-13428.summary: The sign reads ЮЖНО-САХАЛИНСК (Yuzhno-Sakhalinsk). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-13438.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign

ru-lm-13439.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign

ru-lm-13441.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign
ru-lm-13441.summary: The sign reads КУЗНЕЦК (Kuznetsk). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-13565.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign
ru-lm-13565.summary: The sign reads ОРЁЛ (Oryol). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-13566.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign
ru-lm-13566.summary: The sign reads КИСЕЛЁВСК (Kiselyovsk). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-13567.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign
ru-lm-13567.summary: The sign reads БЕРЁЗОВСКИЙ (Beryozovskiy). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-3002.title: Sign: three-stripe pedestrian sign with yellow border
ru-lm-3002.summary: Of the countries with three-stripe pedestrian signs, only Russia has yellow borders.

differs.how: Ukraine's sign has no yellow border
Lithuania's sign has no yellow border
Estonia's sign has no yellow border

ru-lm-9123.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign
ru-lm-9123.summary: The sign reads НОВОСИБИРСК (Novosibirsk). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-9124.summary: The sign reads ЕКАТЕРИНБУРГ (Yekaterinburg). It is written in Cyrillic letters, so place names like this point to Russia or another Cyrillic country.

ru-lm-9126.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign

ru-lm-9278.title: Language: Cyrillic town name sign

ru-lyOi.title: Google car: B-type long antenna, high ridge left
ru-lyOi.summary: The B-type long antenna has its highest ridge on the left. Notable from Yaroslavl to Vladimir, Tula Oblast and around Tuva and Irkutsk.

ru-mXjR.title: Pole: concrete support blocks at the base
ru-mXjR.summary: Utility poles often have concrete support blocks at the bottom, with wooden poles often lifted off the ground by them. Several Central and Eastern European countries have similar blocks.

ru-mZpj.title: Landscape: Caucasus mountains, highest peak
ru-mZpj.summary: The Caucasus is one of the biggest ranges, with the tallest mountain in the country on the border of two republics.

ru-mcGi.title: Language: Chuvash signs say 'урамӗ'
ru-mcGi.summary: Chuvash bilingual signs use урамӗ for street.

ru-mt14.title: Plants: lots of pink fireweed
ru-mt14.summary: Large amounts of pink or red fireweed point to a northern region, and most places north of the capital have it.

ru-pyqm.title: Plants: sparse planted larches, open fields
ru-pyqm.summary: Sparsely planted larches along the road with open rolling fields are common in one Volga republic and nearby areas.

ru-r4Fx.title: Soil: red soil in highlighted areas
ru-r4Fx.summary: Red soil is common around several western regions and in the south-east. Red soil can appear almost anywhere near water or iron mines.

ru-sKGo.title: Language: bilingual signs in two Volga republics
ru-sKGo.summary: Town entry and direction signs show Bashkir or Tatar alongside Russian in the two republics.

ru-sPRH.title: Landscape: grass and bushes, early spring Gen 4
ru-sPRH.summary: Grassy fields with bushes in early spring Gen 4, either flat or mountainous, with common small flowers, point to one Caucasus republic.

ru-ssZ0.title: Houses: big plain concrete apartment blocks
ru-ssZ0.summary: Most city housing is big rectangular concrete apartment blocks. Newer buildings in wealthier areas look more modern.

ru-suQF.title: Coverage: autumn Gen 3 in the west
ru-suQF.summary: Autumn Gen 3 is common in the western exclave, Bryansk, Tula and Belgorod, but the exclave only has autumn coverage.

ru-tmTL.title: Sign: blue sign with English translations
ru-tmTL.summary: Blue signs with English translations of tourist points are only in the capital.

ru-tnNR.title: Houses: richly decorated window frames, often blue
ru-tnNR.summary: Richly decorated window frames on traditional log cabins, often painted blue.

ru-trOH.title: Roads: concrete block roads in the far north
ru-trOH.summary: Further north, some roads are made of several concrete blocks, especially in the Komi region and two Arctic districts.

ru-uO7t.title: Coverage: lots of snow on the ground in Gen 4
ru-uO7t.summary: Gen 4 with plenty of snow on the ground is most common in Saratov and eastern Voronezh.

ru-vEQX.title: Language: Tatar signs say 'урамы'
ru-vEQX.summary: Tatar bilingual signs use урамы (short ур.) for street instead of улица, found in Tatarstan.

ru-vyBb.title: Houses: basic wooden houses with metal roofs
ru-vyBb.summary: Rural housing is mostly basic wooden structures with metal roofs.

ru-wFmP.title: Street sign: transliteration on black
ru-wFmP.summary: Street signs include a Latin transliteration on a black background, mostly downtown in the northern big city.

ru-wOuI.title: Road: unpaved sandy road, stunted bushes
ru-wOuI.summary: The road to the northern island town is unpaved, very sandy, surrounded by short stunted bushes and trees.

ru-wbja.title: Roads: unusually wide intersections
ru-wbja.summary: Many intersections are unusually wide compared to other countries.

ru-xPyY.title: Google car: C-type short antenna, low twisting ridges
ru-xPyY.summary: A low A-type or twisting antenna with the ridges further from the top. Found north and east of the capital, furthest south in Rostov Oblast.

ru-xTY6.title: Coverage: trekkers mostly on the Far East peninsula
ru-xTY6.summary: Most trekkers in the country are on the volcano peninsula, recognisable the same way as the peninsula itself.

ru-y5RK.title: Pole: angled extended insulator bar
ru-y5RK.summary: An angled, extended insulator bar on the pole is found in Chita.

ru-ys4b.title: Plants: palm trees on the Black Sea
ru-ys4b.summary: Tropical plants such as palms only grow on the Black Sea coast, most around Sochi.

ru-z9D5.title: Coverage: winter at two Far East port towns
ru-z9D5.summary: Two eastern port towns have winter coverage similar to the far northern one, but are less flat and barren, with more plants.

ru-zEsz.title: Bollard: three main types
ru-zEsz.summary: Three common bollards: a very thin one on a stick, one with a black top and a red vertical reflector below, and a German-style one.

ru-zTYx.title: Coverage: summer Gen 4
ru-zTYx.summary: Summer Gen 4 is the most common Gen 4 coverage, almost everywhere except the south and parts of the east. Car colour helps divide it.

ru-zl6d.title: Google car: black or white Gen 3, long antenna
ru-zl6d.summary: Gen 3 mostly has a black or white car with a long antenna, or a short antenna with no visible car. Short antenna alone is common across Europe, and black or white long-antenna cars appear in Europe but less often.
